title: Saved View Import Apply Finalization
filters_policy: filters_summary remains human-readable only. Imported saved views use empty filters until a dedicated filters_payload contract is implemented.

next_recommendation.title: Saved View Machine-Readable Filters Payload Contract
next_recommendation.reason: Import apply is now stable, but imported rows intentionally use empty filters because filters_summary is not machine-readable. The next safe step is a contract for filters_payload before lossless import/export.

guardrails: Do not modify Phase 71B implementation in this finalization phase.
Import apply must revalidate payloads before writes.
Invalid payloads must not write rows.
Duplicate saved views must be skipped, not overwritten.
Imported saved views must remain scoped to the authenticated user.
filters_summary must not be treated as machine-readable filters.
Keep preview, export, bulk selection, and pagination stable.
